description: The table of contents of Hendrik Kleinwächter's open-source book The Sourdough Framework: every chapter and section with its number and each chapter's length in words. read_sourdough_book returns any of them in full. The book covers starters, fermentation, flour, hydration, shaping, baking and troubleshooting.
name: get_sourdough_book_contents
title: Contents of The Sourdough Framework
